images.caption: LIBI_00312_11151; Albumen photograph. This image depicts a wide-angle view of a town. There is a rocky ledge in the foreground and hills in the background. White letters in the bottom right corner of the image read “Black Hills, NO. 536. Sturgis, D.T.” A handwritten note along the bottom margin reads: “Fort Meade near town. 1886”. Fort Mead is located in South Dakota, 14 miles northeast of Deadwood on Bear Butte Creek. This image is the original. It was taken by W.R. Cross in 1886.  ; album, photograph;Courtesy of the National Park Service, Little Bighorn Battlefield National Monument, LIBI_00312_11151, W. R. Cross, "Fort Mead, Wide View," 1886
